predecessors.name: Mtetwa Paramountcy
predecessors.text: the Zulu country under Dingiswayo's Mtetwa Paramountcy (infobox predecessor)

successors.name: Natalia Republic (Republic of Natalia)
successors.text: Zululand annexed to the Colony of Natal in 1897

successors.name: Nieuwe Republiek (New Republic)
successors.text: the north-west of Zululand granted to the Boers in 1884 (1,355,000 morgen; the republic's area 13,600 km2 gives the radius), capital Vryheid

ledger.x: 1816: Shaka comes to power and founds the Zulu kingdom.
1828: the capital moves from kwaBulawayo to uMgungundlovu with Dingane.
3-4 February 1838: Dingane cedes the land south of the Tugela to the Voortrekkers.
1840: the capital moves to Ulundi with Mpande.
4 July 1879: the Battle of Ulundi ends the war.
16 August 1884: Dinuzulu grants the north-west to the Boers.

wars.name: Shaka's wars against the Ndwandwe
wars.outcome: Zwide's first assault failed at Gqokli Hill (1818); Shaka defeated him at the Mhlatuze River in 1820, breaking the Ndwandwe alliance.

wars.name: Zulu-Voortrekker war and the Battle of Blood River
wars.outcome: Dingane ceded the land south of the Tugela (February 1838); Pretorius's forces held at Blood River on 16 December 1838; the Boers formed Natalia 'south of the Tugela' in 1839.

wars.name: Zulu invasion of Swaziland
wars.outcome: Mpande invaded Swaziland in 1852 and the British pressured him to withdraw.

wars.name: Anglo-Zulu War
wars.outcome: British victory at Ulundi (4 July 1879) after Isandlwana (22 January); Cetshwayo captured on 28 August and the kingdom divided into thirteen chiefdoms.

wars.name: Zulu Civil War (Usuthu against Zibhebhu)
wars.outcome: Zibhebhu attacked Cetshwayo's kraal at Ulundi on 22 July 1883; the Boers and Dinuzulu defeated him at Tshaneni on 5 June 1884; the Boers received the north-west.

certainty.note: The Pongola and Tugela rivers are the only lines the page names; nothing was surveyed.
The thirteen chiefdoms (1879), the 1883 reserve and the 1884 grant of 1,355,000 morgen have no boundaries on the pages.
